actions.command: ls -la && file input.cfg output.cfg 2>/dev/null; xxd input.cfg | head -c 4000; echo; echo "==== HEX DUMP FULL ===="; xxd input.cfg

python3 -c '
with open("input.cfg", "rb") as f:
    data = f.read()
print(repr(data))
old = b"environment=staging"
new = b"environment=production"
if data.count(old) != 1:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected count: {data.count(old)}")
out = data.replace(old, new, 1)
with open("output.cfg", "wb") as f:
    f.write(out)
print("written", len(out), "bytes")
'
# verify
echo "==== INPUT ===="
xxd input.cfg
echo "==== OUTPUT ===="
xxd output.cfg
echo "==== CMP INPUT UNCHANGED ===="
# ensure input wasn't modified - compare to expected original
python3 -c '
with open("input.cfg","rb") as f: d=f.read()
assert d == bytes.fromhex("efbbbf656e7669726f6e6d656e743d73746167696e670d0a23206b656570207468697320636f6d6d656e740a706f72743d383038300d0a"), "input changed!"
print("input intact")
with open("output.cfg","rb") as f: o=f.read()
expected = d.replace(b"environment=staging", b"environment=production", 1)
assert o == expected, "output mismatch"
assert o.startswith(b"\xef\xbb\xbf")
assert b"environment=production" in o
assert b"environment=staging" not in o
assert o[o.find(b"production")+10:o.find(b"production")+12] == b"\r\n"
print("output correct")
print(repr(o))
'
